001package dev.nandi0813.api.Interface;
002
003import java.util.List;
004import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
005import org.bukkit.util.BoundingBox;
006
007/**
008 * Read-only state of a bot practice round as one bot sees it, passed to {@link BotOpponent#tick(BotFightView)}.
009 * Each bot receives its own view. Only valid during that call; do not keep a reference.
010 */
011public interface BotFightView {
012
013    /**
014     * @return The team of the bot this view belongs to: 0 is the human team, 1 the bot team
015     */
016    int getTeam();
017
018    /**
019     * @return Living enemy fighters of this round, humans and bots, in a stable order. A new unmodifiable list; empty when none
020     */
021    List<Player> getEnemies();
022
023    /**
024     * @return Living teammates of this round, humans and bots, excluding the bot itself. A new unmodifiable list; empty when none
025     */
026    List<Player> getAllies();
027
028    /**
029     * @return The match id, see {@link Match#getMatchId()}
030     */
031    String getMatchId();
032
033    /**
034     * @return The current round number, starting at 1
035     */
036    int getRoundNumber();
037
038    /**
039     * @return Ticks since this round became live, starting at 0; 0 during the countdown
040     */
041    int getRoundTicks();
042
043    /**
044     * @return True while the round is live. False during the start countdown, when the body must not move, attack
045     * or shoot, but may eat and use potions
046     */
047    boolean isLive();
048
049    /**
050     * @return A copy of the arena bounds
051     */
052    BoundingBox getArenaBounds();
053
054    /**
055     * @return Fighters at or below this block Y die
056     */
057    int getDeadZoneY();
058
059    /**
060     * @return The ladder name, never null
061     */
062    String getLadderName();
063
064}
